about: Model decisions recorded from a genuine Gemini run on the bundled sample data (INVOICE_CHASER_TODAY=2026-10-24). Replayed through the real ADK runner, MCP server and ledger so the demo works without API quota. Amounts, statuses and the number guard are computed live by the ledger; only the model's choices are replayed.
